meta.title: Trim MCP server tool payloads to reduce token consumption
meta.body_summary: Add trimmed responses for Azure DevOps MCP server tools to dramatically reduce LLM token consumption while maintaining backward compatibility via an optional fullResponse parameter.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added trimmed responses with fullResponse toggle; maintainer requested code improvements (helper function, error checking) via inline comments, then approved; merged with ~50% token reduction claims.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 5522 total changed lines, this is a large change by absolute volume; however, the core performance change in repos.ts is roughly 150 lines, with the rest coming from a merge-update that pulled in many unrelated repository-wide updates. The outcome aligns with a moderate incremental performance PR that merged after iterative review.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer nikolapeja6 requested extracting comment trimming into a reusable helper function and adding error checks for comment creation and thread resolution; Copilot iterated with commits, and all review comments were addressed.
review_details.performance_claim: Trims API responses to reduce token consumption, e.g., resolve_comment from 1346 to 37 chars (97.3% reduction).

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot can implement backend response trimming with an opt‑in flag; merge required iterative refinement of helper function extraction and error handling per maintainer feedback.

detection_detail.code_reading: nikolapeja6 reviewed the implementation, requested structural improvements (trimComments helper) and error validation for comment creation and thread resolution.
detection_detail.ci_auto: github-actions bot performed dependency review (no vulnerabilities found) and labeled the PR as stale and needing attention before review activity resumed.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body lists token savings (e.g., 97.3% reduction) but no automated benchmark; reviewer approved without independent performance measurement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Inline review comments led to commits extracting trimComments helper, adding error checks, and simplifying conditionals; no revert or follow‑up issues.

core_change_summary.description: In src/tools/repos.ts, added a fullResponse parameter to repo_resolve_comment, repo_reply_to_comment, repo_list_pull_request_threads, and repo_list_pull_request_thread_comments. When fullResponse is false (default), action tools return simple success strings and list tools return filtered data excluding deleted comments, _links objects, and verbose author properties. Added a trimComments helper and error validation for comment creation and thread resolution.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The merge commit cec490e brought in many unrelated repository‑wide changes (README, CI workflows, new tests, etc.) that are not part of the performance change.
